implementation: Shared pure grid,representative-color,raster,marker and alpha-overlay functions;source-supported zoom dimensions and explicit palette/AUT inputs.
The world copies the minimap window through bounded map-cache strips,including original zero padding and actual map revision/center/selector.
The resource library owns bounded on-demand tile colors and explicit AUT reads;it does not generate guessed map colors or reuse stale unread AUT tails.
One thin minimap owner is shared by web and wx hosts.Asynchronous resource preparation is generation-checked;completed overlays are composited synchronously into the next ordinary frame.

Browser/Page offer show-hide and range controls.The independent UI defaults hidden and places the overlay at the top right;native palette/hardware/window placement and complete global cadence are not asserted.
ownership: Minimap snapshots,grids,AUT bytes and temporary pixels are owned and cleared on replacement/close.Main game requests are not replayed by minimap preparation.Missing minimap material is a visible unavailable state.
acceptance: Meaningful independent original palette/grid/raster/blink/ownership cases and source/generated comparisons.
Actual CUT/AUT paired material through mode1 static and animated scene paths,navigation and minimap colors.
Web desktop/touch and source/generated Page controls,scene reload,hide/show/range and disposal.
Appropriate full regression,build input/output hashes and13 canonical documentation updates.
remaining: Full native scheduler,hardware palette and16/24-bit rendering backend equivalence.
Unobserved gameplay/RID/self/mixed/empty/local-stop contexts,current handoff and full resource-version compatibility.
Native WeChat/physical-phone/file/audio and official-account/server acceptance;37 original requirements and10 incomplete groups remain.
